speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition better, could you tell me if you have noticed any drooping of your eyelids or any changes in your speech or swallowing? Also, does the weakness or double vision seem to get worse as the day progresses or with repeated activity?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening symptoms with activity and improvement with rest is very characteristic. Have you noticed any difficulty with chewing or swallowing, or do you experience any muscle twitching or cramping?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Do you have any difficulty breathing or feel shortness of breath, especially when lying flat? Additionally, has anyone mentioned that your neck seems weak, such as having trouble holding your head up?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had trouble swallowing or slurred speech. I also have not noticed breathing difficulty, and the symptoms started gradually about a month ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will now proceed with diagnostic testing to confirm the clinical suspicion. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody_Test REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_Nerve_Stimulation
